annotations.title: Low Resource Relevance
annotations.explanation: Resources are frequently wasted or unused.
annotations.suggestion: Increase resource sinks, scaling costs, or late-game conversion.

annotations.title: High Flavor Choice Rate
annotations.explanation: 79% of turns present choices that lead to identical outcomes.
annotations.suggestion: Differentiate action payoffs  ensure moves have meaningfully different consequences.

annotations.title: Luck-Dominated Game
annotations.explanation: Skill-Luck Index is -1.00  chance outweighs skill.
annotations.suggestion: Reduce output randomness, add strategic mitigation of luck, or increase decision weight.

annotations.title: Early Resource Monopolization
annotations.explanation: Peak Gini coefficient reaches 0.67 before 75% completion  runaway leader risk.
annotations.suggestion: Implement catch-up mechanics, dynamic game balancing, or diminishing returns on leads.

annotations.title: Collapsed Win Curve
annotations.explanation: Trailing players at the midpoint have near-zero chance of winning.
annotations.suggestion: Add rubber-banding, hidden objectives, or late-game swing opportunities.

annotations.title: Brittle Outcome Resolution
annotations.explanation: 75% of games were decided by a single large score swing.
annotations.suggestion: Add buffers against bad luck  backup plans, insurance mechanics, or diminishing returns on swings.
